Counsel for Applicant :- Surya Prakash
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Pankaj Bhatia,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Akhilesh Kumar Vyas, learned A.G.A. and perused the record.
2. The applicant seeks enlargement on bail in FIR No.240 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Singahi, District Lakhimpur Kheri.
3. It is argued by the Counsel for the applicant that the applicant is the husband of the deceased.
He further argues that the father-in-law of the deceased was granted bail vide order dated 10.04.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.4001 of 2024.

sentences.text:

1 noticed the facts and the allegations in paras 3 and 4 of the said bail order dated 10.04.2024.
4. Learned A.G.A. vehemently opposed the bail prayer.

5. Considering the reasoning as assigned in the said bail order dated 10.04.2024, which are applicable to the applicant also and the fact that the applicant is in custody since 29.01.2024 and has no criminal antecedents, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, the bail application is allowed.

6. Let the applicant Rajkumar be released on bail in the abovesaid first information report number on his furnishing personal bonds and two reliable sureties of Rs.20,000/- each to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
